name: Brilliant Big & Blind Bravo Orlando 2026

venue.name: Black Belt Center
venue.details: Enter through the black double doors on the side of the building.

information: **3x3 Blindfolded is the main event of this competition.** If you are competing in 3x3 Multi-Blind, please contact the organization team before registration closes to submit the projected number of cubes you plan to attempt. You can modify this amount at the competition, but having an estimate ahead of time helps us to generate the appropriate number of scrambles. This competition is supported by [Southeast Cubing, Inc.](https://southeastcubing.org/about), the official nonprofit organization for speedcubing in the Southeast! Please check out the [Southeast Cubing, Inc. tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BrilliantBigBlindBravo2026#73234-southeast-cubing-inc-florida-cubing) to learn more about the organization and what you can do to support the mission. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6Mzc5MDYsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--55d04463db7d97e68854ce1ad4ffb960c1ed23fd/SOUTHEAST_5.png)
